posts.author: buddysievers
posts.body:
Itch.io
is a good option if you want legal assets. It offers both free and paid 16-bit style pixel art packs.
You can also look into
REFMAP
. It is not exactly 16-bit styled, but it has a fairly similar look and is completely legal to use.
Keep in mind that most actual 16-bit era games used 16×16 tiles. For RPG Maker XP, VX, and VX Ace, you will usually want to scale them by a factor of 2. For MV and MZ, you would scale them by a factor of 3.
Kind of unrelated, but when using
mkxp-z
with RPG Maker XP, VX, or VX Ace, it is possible to use high-resolution graphics. For example, you can use 48×48 tiles in a 32×32 tile environment, since the engine automatically scales them down.
